title: Validate the whole batch before changing caller state
task_type: Unity Editor asset and build verification
environment: Bounded in-memory Unity generators/migrations. This does not establish disk rollback or immunity to errors after the commit boundary.
goal: Add generated parameters to a caller-owned Animator controller.
approach: Historical failed assumption: Validation interleaved with per-item mutation was assumed to make rejection atomic.
what_worked: Historical correction: Preflight the complete reserved-name/type set before any addition. For transformations that can fail midway, prepare isolated results before committing them. Verification reported by the source: Twelve later-name/type collision cases preserved parameters, layers and clips after rejection. A related migration fault control preserved full serialization and original object identities using clone-transform-commit.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: A collision with a later reserved name rejected the build after earlier parameters had already been appended.
why: Confirmed: the append loop changed state before discovering all conflicts.
improved_method: Validate every batch constraint before the first mutation, and stage fallible transformations before commit. Test a last-item conflict and compare the whole pre-state.
when_to_use: Bounded in-memory Unity generators/migrations. This does not establish disk rollback or immunity to errors after the commit boundary.
when_not_to_use: This does not establish disk rollback or immunity to errors after the commit boundary.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
